title: Surround · verb
subtitle: 「環繞／圍住／在四周／夾在兩側」，究竟是哪一種 surround？
description: 「環繞／圍住／在四周／夾在兩側」，究竟是哪一種 surround？

words.note: 使用者提供。encircle 是 surround 的正式近義詞，強調形成一個完整或接近完整的圓圈／環帶。常見於 walls, mountains, troops, roads, rings 等。
words.example: A ring of hills encircles the village.

exercises.original: A line of trees surrounds the lake on every side.
exercises.zh: 一排樹木從四面環繞著湖泊。
exercises.upgrade: encircle · 環繞；圍住；形成一圈

options.explanation: on every side + lake strongly suggests a ring-like arrangement.
強調由牆、圍欄或邊界把空間圈在裡面，帶 containment 感。 本題的決定性線索是 forming a complete ring around a place；這裡需要的是「形成完整環圈」。因此 enclose 雖與 surround 有空間語義重疊，但究竟是完整環圈、封閉邊界、四周存在、受困、雙側位置或沿邊界延伸並不最吻合。

falseSynonyms.zh: encircle 強調形成完整或近完整圓環；surround 更廣，不要求幾何上的圈。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Hills encircle the valley. Tall buildings surround the station.

falseSynonyms.zh: enclose 強調把空間封在邊界裡；surround 只需位於四周。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A fence encloses the garden. Trees surround the house.

falseSynonyms.zh: ring 常有可見的一圈人／物；surround 不一定呈規整環帶。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Spectators ringed the court. Buildings surrounded the square.

falseSynonyms.zh: hem in 額外表示空間受壓縮、行動或擴展受到限制；中性 surround 沒有這層。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The village is hemmed in by mountains. The village is surrounded by hills.

falseSynonyms.zh: flank 只表示左右兩側；surround 通常至少暗示更多方向。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Columns flank the entrance. Trees surround the courtyard.

falseSynonyms.zh: border 表示沿邊緣／邊界排列；surround 表示在四周形成外圍。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Trees border the road. Hills surround the town.

falseSynonyms.zh: cover 表示覆蓋表面或遮住；surround 表示位於外圍四周。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Snow covered the ground. Mountains surrounded the valley.

falseSynonyms.zh: surround 是動詞；surrounding 可作形容詞／名詞，表示周圍的／環境。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Trees surround the house. The surrounding area is quiet.
